title: The Origin of the 24 Solar Terms
prompt: Explain the origin and purpose of the 24 solar terms in ancient China.
hint: Describe how ancient Chinese scholars observed natural phenomena and divided the sun's movements.
sample: Ancient Chinese scholars observed the climate, seasons, and astronomy, dividing the sun's annual movements into 24 solar terms to guide agriculture.

ja.prompt: 古代中国の24節気の起源と目的を説明してください。
ja.hint: 古代の学者たちが自然現象を観察し、太陽の動きをどのように分割したかを説明しましょう。
ja.sample: 古代の中国の学者たちは気候や季節、天文学を観察し、太陽の年間の動きを24の節気に分けて農業を管理しました。

zh.sample: 古代中國學者觀察氣候、季節和天文，將太陽的年度運動分為24節氣，用以指導農業。

title: Winter Swimming Tradition in Xiaoshing
prompt: Describe the tradition of winter swimming in Xiaoshing and its significance.
hint: Explain what winter swimming is, when it happens, and why locals participate.
sample: Winter swimming in Xiaoshing is swimming outdoors in cold water below 17°C, starting symbolically on the first day of winter, promoting health and community spirit.

ja.hint: 冬泳とは何か、いつ行われるのか、なぜ地元の人々が参加するのかを説明しましょう。
ja.sample: 小興の冬泳は水温17度以下の冷たい水で屋外泳ぐことで、冬の始まりの日に象徴的に始まり、健康と地域の絆を促進します。

title: The Role of Yeast in Chinese Rice Wine
prompt: Explain the importance of yeast in the production of Chinese rice wine.
hint: Discuss how yeast derived from grain mold is essential for fermentation and flavor development.
sample: Yeast, derived from grain mold, is the essence of Chinese rice wine making, enabling fermentation and creating unique flavors.
